status: Blocked upstream compiler bug; legacy-mode adoption withdrawn; production compiler configuration unchanged

configuration.consumer: Production Vite invokes the actual Storybook viteFinal compiler configuration

cause.rule: Added selector specificity uses the ordinal index of present floor(priority / 1000) buckets, not the numeric priority

alternatives.styleResolution: All three supported values produce the same scalar priority mismatch
alternatives.useCSSLayers: Also bundle-relative: identical opacity shifts priority1 to priority3; scale shifts priority2 to priority4
alternatives.staleOutputs: Excluded by repeated empty-scratch fresh token/UI builds and production consumer builds

rejectedScratchPublicProcessorFlag.change: Explicit --legacy applies the experimental CJS/ESM forwarding patch and enables legacyDisableLayers only in scratch package/consumer configs; no compiler implementation changes
rejectedScratchPublicProcessorFlag.cause: Consumer padding-top and package padding shorthand have equal specificity after synthetic priority is disabled; later package stylesheet resets the consumer longhand
rejectedScratchPublicProcessorFlag.publicPluginOptionsProbe: CJS and ESM Vite adapters both forward true with the experimental patch; omitted flag equals false, preserving default CSS

rejectedApplicationOrder.styleResolution: application-order in fresh token/UI and consumer compilation
rejectedApplicationOrder.directionalAfterLatePackageCSS: LTR and RTL both resolve left/right padding to package24 rather than caller logical/physical values
rejectedApplicationOrder.matchingModesProven: Fresh package map and consumer compiled together; package shorthand key kmVPX3 retains xggk2y7 while dynamic consumer physical paddingTop uses kLKAdn with x1jm3axb and --x-paddingTop29px
rejectedApplicationOrder.falsifiedHypothesis: application-order does not expand padding into longhands; it retains the shorthand declaration and overlapping null keys
rejectedApplicationOrder.compilerKeyABI: StyleResolution controls overlap/null-key metadata used by stylex.props; source packages and consumers must rebuild in the same mode. Matching mode alone does not eliminate the stylesheet-order failure

supportedAPI.processor: Default export from @stylexjs/babel-plugin exposes processStylexRules(rules, { useLayers, enableLTRRTLComments, legacyDisableLayers?: boolean }) in lib/index.d.ts
supportedAPI.unplugin: UserOptions in lib/core.d.ts already declares legacyDisableLayers?: boolean and is re-exported by lib/index.d.ts
supportedAPI.missingBehavior: Runtime collectCss and processCollectedRulesToCSS do not forward the declared option
supportedAPI.experimentalPatch: unplugin-forwarding.experimental.patch extracts the existing typed flag, defaults false and forwards collectCss to processStylexRules in CJS and ESM
supportedAPI.rejection: Removing specificity tiers is not semantically safe across independent sheets: package shorthand can overwrite a later-composed consumer physical longhand
supportedAPI.decision: No active patchedDependencies registration, no legacy:true production options, no dependency version changes; experimental forwarding patch retained only for reproducing the rejected approach
